name: Nike Air Max 95 'Big Bubble - Granite'
story_html: The Nike Air Max 95 'Big Bubble - Granite' updates the retro runner with a tonal color palette. Rope laces feed through white webbing eyelets to secure the upper, featuring wavy synthetic suede panels in a gradient grey design. The lace cover and molded heel panel, marked with debossed Nike Air branding, feature a reflective matte silver finish. Anchoring the sneaker is a black polyurethane midsole with exposed Air-Sole cushioning, highlighted by the original 'Big Bubble' heel unit.
